mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shelter_auth_applications (user_id, shelter_name, contact_person, business_license, qualification_file, description, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{request.shelterName}, #{request.contactPerson}, #{request.businessLicense}, #{request.qualificationFile}, #{request.description}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shelter_auth_applications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0

SELECT id, user_id, shelter_name, contact_person, business_license, qualification_file, status, description, audit_reason, created_at, audit_time, CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN status = 1 THEN '审核通过' WHEN status = 2 THEN '审核不通过' ELSE '未知状态' END AS status_str FROM shelter_auth_applications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, shelter_name, contact_person, business_license, qualification_file, status, description, audit_reason, created_at, audit_time, CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN status = 1 THEN '审核通过' WHEN status = 2 THEN '审核不通过' ELSE '未知状态' END AS status_str FROM shelter_auth_applications WHERE id = #{applicationId}

SELECT saa.id, saa.user_id, saa.shelter_name, saa.contact_person, saa.business_license, saa.qualification_file, saa.status, saa.description, saa.audit_reason, saa.created_at, saa.audit_time, u.username, CASE WHEN saa.status = 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN saa.status = 1 THEN '审核通过' WHEN saa.status = 2 THEN '审核不通过' ELSE '未知状态' END AS status_str FROM shelter_auth_applications saa JOIN users u ON saa.user_id = u.id WHERE saa.status = 0 ORDER BY saa.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE shelter_auth_applications SET status = #{status}, audit_reason = #{auditReason}, audit_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{applicationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shelters (shelter_name, contact_person, business_license, qualification_file, user_id) SELECT shelter_name, contact_person, business_license, qualification_file, user_id FROM shelter_auth_applications WHERE id = #{applicationId} AND status = 1
